description: interpolation by 4 with a root raised cosine on complex samples vs interp_fir_filter_ccf

fixed_vs_float.rationale: Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 2.609336720246821e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 6.547943568257871 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q15 (sum of |tap rounding error| 2.609336720246821e-4) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 1.0 LSB of output rounding (Q15) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 7.047943568257871 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

Taps rounded to Q17 (sum of |tap rounding error| 8.617887629108929e-5) acting on an input peak of 0.705 FS per component, plus 0.5 LSB of output rounding (Q17) and 0.02 Q15 LSB for the f32 reference itself; per component <= 2.135856139906022 Q15 LSB, x sqrt(2) for the complex magnitude. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.

float_vs_gnuradio.rationale: f32 rounding in an 41-tap sum: each of the n additions errs by at most 2^-24 of the partial sum (<= peak * sum|taps| = 4.246223721879612); twice that covers both evaluation orders (GNU Radio uses SIMD kernels): 0.9617 Q15 LSB. SNR minimum is the measured value minus 1 dB.
